scenario.name: Lahaina wildfire, 8 Aug 2023 (compressed)

timeline.note: Scenario start ≈ 14:55 HST: the morning Lahainaluna fire, declared contained, rekindles upslope in 60+ mph downslope winds (Hurricane Dora pressure gradient). Times below are COMPRESSED (~3 h → 30 min).
Flare-up east of the Lahaina Bypass near Lahainaluna Rd (approximate origin area).
Front crosses the bypass and runs downslope along Lahainaluna Rd.
Smoke column blown west over Lahainaluna Rd / Kuialua St.
Cell sites lose power / burn; 911 and alerts degrade (MPD after-action report).
Front St camera obscured by dense smoke: street-level vision goes blind here (the smoke false-negative).
Downed poles / debris on Front St near Dickenson St.
Front reaches the Honoapiilani Hwy / Lahainaluna Rd area.
Spot fire south of Shaw St.
Gridlock on Front St north of Papalaua St.
Fire reaches the shoreline through the town core between Papalaua St and Shaw St; the highway north of Wahikuli and south of Shaw St is still passable (approximate).
Debris cleared by residents (community all_clear corroborates).
End of compressed window (≈ 18:00 HST). Fire continued into the night; this scenario stops here.
